title: High-valence corner regression test for AssignBezierHandlesNode
description: After extrude/inset, cage corners can have 5+ edges meeting. AssignBezierHandlesNode.handleOffsetAtVertex averages adjacent edge directions - behavior at high valence is untested. Add regression test: build cage, do two overlapping extrudes creating a 6-valent corner, run assign_bezier_handles + coons_patch, verify output is watertight with no NaN vertices.
definition-of-done: 1. HighValenceCornerTest class added. 2. Test covers 5-valent and 6-valent corners. 3. Output mesh watertight and NaN-free.
testing-plan: 1. Run test after other plan changes. 2. If fails, file follow-up ticket for AssignBezierHandlesNode fix.
